escalation_note: Two tight crops, both to settle glyph identity rather than truth. At 600 dpi the p2 Column A / Column B block rendered summary line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (See Schedule A)' as a plain unslashed handwritten oval ZERO in Column A beside '$7065.54' in Column B, and line 2 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (See Schedule B)' as the same oval zero in Column A beside '$7065.54' in Column B. The glyph DENOTES the digit zero (this filer writes ordinary round zeros throughout, including inside 7065.54), so it reads 0 under the zero-glyph ruling — it is not a dash and not an empty cell. At 700 dpi the p2 foliation box rendered 'Page [1] of [1]' in the filer's blue ink over 'Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name  SMITH' — the direct page-face evidence that the two-page document is complete as filed.
notes: Page-face candidate 'JEFFERY DEAN SMITH' in block capitals, signed 'JEFFERY D. SMITH' (party 'REP', Office Seeking 'UT-COUNTY RECORDER', residence city Orem); index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it, and it agrees with the channel's 'County Recorder'. Entirely handwritten in blue ballpoint. The whole document is TWO PAGES (pdfinfo), both read full-page: p1 the county's 2014 blank cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) with '30 Days after the General Election' ticked and signed 12/3/14; p2 the SUMMARY PAGE. BOTH SIDES ARE no-schedule-page, NOT empty-schedule — there is no Schedule A and no Schedule B sheet in the retained PDF to be blank, which is a different fact and is recorded as such; the evidence is the pdfinfo page count plus the filer's own 'Page 1 of 1' foliation on the summary page. THE ARITHMETIC IS COMPLETE AND CLOSED WITHOUT THEM: Column A ('Total this Period') states a handwritten zero for both TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED and TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE, and every line of the balance ladder — 3 beginning, 4 contributions, 5 subtotal, 6 expenditures, 7 close — is the same written zero, so the period had no activity to itemize and the ladder closes 0 + 0 - 0 = 0. Column B ('Year-to-Date Total') carries real cycle figures, 7,065.54 contributions and 7,065.54 expenditures, which are CUMULATIVE and are never summed as an increment and never used to synthesize a per-period figure; the two being equal is the filer's statement that the campaign account is wound up. Note against ADDENDUM A §A4 / ADDENDUM C §C6: this final report does NOT zero its cumulative column — it keeps real YTD figures while zeroing the period column, the opposite of the 2010 Poulson December case, which is why neither behaviour may be assumed. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither the Yes nor the No box is ticked, an honest BLANK, never read as 'No'. FOLIATION: 'Page 1 of 1' on the summary page, i.e. the cover is excluded from the count — a further practice alongside those already on record, and here it is load-bearing evidence rather than a nuisance.
